title: Talk in cards
old_caption: Scorpio tried to peek at Libra's sealed answer and got caught instantly. Libra's hill to die on? People who peek. What's yours?

title: A new deck every night
old_caption: The stars are dealing tonight, green visor and all. Six cards, no endless scroll, and the little YOU star still asks for more. Which sign is always begging for one more?

title: What color is your aura?
old_caption: Leo came out gold, Pisces came out sea green and already crying, and Scorpio pressed both eyes to the lens and said no photos. Drop your aura color below.

title: Houston, the stars are dealing
old_caption: Twelve sign stars rushed the founding card over Houston. Sag said ten minutes away, which in this city means an hour. Who in your crew is always ten minutes away?

title: Spark · Rub · Align
old_caption: Two Venus-ruled signs: Taurus will not budge, Libra cannot decide. They sparked, they bonked twice, and somehow they still lined up. Which pair in your life is exactly this?

title: Put your faith in the stars
old_caption: Scorpio drops a velvet curtain over the face, Virgo reads a chart scroll that will not stop unrolling, and job three just stares at you. Yes, you. Ready to take it?

title: Two charts walk into a date
old_caption: Two stars walk into a date with their charts, and Virgo arrives with a protractor. Easy at 120, a click at 60, spicy at 90. Which angle are you and your person?

title: Astrology in 60 seconds
old_caption: Sixty seconds, one stopwatch, the Sun driving laps, Aries demanding to go first and Saturn asleep at the wheel. A full astrology class with time to spare. What's your Big Three?

title: Everyone sounds the same.
old_caption: Love to travel. Fluent in sarcasm. Partner in crime. The gold star fell asleep halfway through. Then the Sagittarius rising said it actually does love to travel. Fair.

title: The most honest thing about you
old_caption: 6'2 (ish). Loves hiking (once). No drama (sure). The gold star stamps every line of the bio, and then the birth time shows up with nothing to fix. What's the boldest bio fib you've seen?
